verdict.rationale: GitHub's docs pack shows CI/CD (github-docs-11), secret scanning (github-docs-7), and dependency remediation (github-docs-6) which support governance-adjacent capabilities, but there is no specific evidence of org-wide policy enforcement (branch protection rules, required reviewers, rulesets) across teams/repos. Community evidence even flags recurring Actions reliability issues (github-comm-18) that could undermine CI/CD policy enforcement at scale.
